name: smwmusic-spider-man-and-the-x-men-in-arcade-s-revenge-gambit
title: Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge - Gambit
description:
One of Follin's best works on the SNES, this long track doesn't really fit into any level theme, but maybe it could work in an urban/athletic setting.
I tried my best to replicate everything, and considering the limitations of the N-SPC engine I think it turned out fairly accurate.

Note: not compatible with thunder sfx/Blarggs or with the "Bonus end" global song.

Update:
- Added sample group.
- Compiled with AMK 1.0.8, so the SPC doesn't have slowdown.
- Removed staccato in a bunch of places. Now the bass is THICC like in the original, but it also has a bit of noticeable clicking.
- Small edits/fixes.
